fractional_ratio_powers.name: Fractional Powers of Ratios
fractional_ratio_powers.observation: A master of reckoning writes a ratio raised to a half or a third power, and growth and decay can be compared on one scale.

turning_earth_argument.name: A Turning Earth Argued
turning_earth_argument.observation: A learned cleric argues that the earth might turn beneath the stars, and then, for the peace of the schools, sets the thought aside.

ruler_founded_universities.name: Rulers' Own Universities
ruler_founded_universities.observation: Each prince now founds a university in his own realm, so that his judges and clerks need not study under a rival's crown.
ruler_founded_universities.ability_reason: Universities multiply under princely charters; every realm now trains its own lawyers, physicians and clerks at home.
ruler_founded_universities.social_consequence: Scholars swear to the prince who pays them, and learning takes the colours of the realm

graticule_world_maps.name: World on a Grid of Degrees
graticule_world_maps.observation: Copied from a recovered old book, the world is drawn on a net of degrees, and every place can be named by two numbers.
graticule_world_maps.ability_reason: Places fixed by degrees of latitude and longitude can be carried from map to map without redrawing the whole coast.

mirror_grid_perspective.name: Perspective Proved by Mirror
mirror_grid_perspective.observation: A builder holds a painted panel against its reflection in a mirror, and the lines of the square meet at one point as the eye sees them.
mirror_grid_perspective.ability_reason: Single-point perspective gives builders and painters one rule for drawing depth, so plans and pictures can be measured.

old_tongue_grammar_schools.name: Old-tongue Grammar Schools
old_tongue_grammar_schools.observation: The sons of rulers and merchants learn the old learned tongue from printed grammars and read its orators aloud.
old_tongue_grammar_schools.social_consequence: A child who reads the old tongue can rise at court; one who cannot stays in the shop

burin_engraving.observation: A goldsmith pushes a lozenge-pointed graver through copper, and the furrow holds ink finer than any carved block.

copperplate_preparation.name: Prepared Copper Plates
copperplate_preparation.observation: Copper is hammered, planished and rubbed with charcoal until the plate is flat enough to take a hair line.

remeasured_star_catalogue.name: Re-measured Star Catalogue
remeasured_star_catalogue.observation: Observers at the great instruments re-measure a thousand stars and find the old catalogue wrong by a moon's width.

philological_forgery_critique.name: Forgery Exposed by Its Words
philological_forgery_critique.observation: A scholar shows that the famous grant uses words no clerk of its supposed age could have known, and the forgery falls.
philological_forgery_critique.social_consequence: Old titles and privileges can now be questioned by anyone who can read their grammar

screw_press_printing.name: Screw Press Printing
screw_press_printing.observation: The pressman pulls the bar, the platen comes down evenly on the forme, and three hundred sheets are printed before noon.
screw_press_printing.ability_reason: A screw press prints evenly from set type; books multiply by the hundred, and the same text reaches every town.
screw_press_printing.social_consequence: Copyists lose their trade, and any quarrel set in type is read in every market

oil_based_printing_inks.name: Oil Printing Inks
oil_based_printing_inks.observation: Linseed oil is boiled into varnish and ground with lampblack, and the ink stays on the metal letters instead of running.

hand_relief_printing.name: Hand-pulled Relief Printing
hand_relief_printing.observation: One man beats the type with leather ink balls while his fellow lays the sheet and pulls, all day by the window.

metal_type_casting.name: Cast Metal Type
metal_type_casting.observation: Hot lead, tin and antimony run into a hand mould, and the struck matrix gives a letter that matches its hundred brothers.
metal_type_casting.ability_reason: Type cast by hand from struck matrices is uniform and endless; one set of punches can supply a whole printing town.
metal_type_casting.social_consequence: Type founders guard their punches, and the letter shapes of one shop spread across realms

printed_scripture_folio.name: Printed Scripture Folio
printed_scripture_folio.observation: The great printed folio of the god's books is chained in the nave, every copy the same to the last stop.

printed_broadsides.name: Street Broadsides
printed_broadsides.observation: Sheets of news, hymns and quarrels are sold for a small coin at the market cross and read aloud to those who cannot.
printed_broadsides.social_consequence: A rumour printed is a rumour believed; rulers now answer libels with their own sheets

town_printing_houses.name: Printing Houses in Every Town
town_printing_houses.observation: Every trading town now has its printing house by the market, turning out almanacs, sermons, grammars and ledger forms.
town_printing_houses.ability_reason: With a press in every trading town, new work spreads in months rather than generations and old books are no longer lost.
town_printing_houses.social_consequence: Printers, booksellers and their readers become a public that argues back

printed_ephemerides.name: Printed Sky Tables
printed_ephemerides.observation: Pilots and physicians buy printed tables that give the sun, moon and planets for every day of the coming years.

printed_engraved_maps.name: Printed Copper Maps
printed_engraved_maps.observation: Maps cut in copper are printed by the hundred, so the same coast and the same roads hang in every counting house.

printed_arithmetic_summa.name: Printed Summa of Reckoning
printed_arithmetic_summa.observation: A printed summa teaches rules of three, geometry and the double-entry ledger, and every merchant's clerk carries one.
printed_arithmetic_summa.ability_reason: Double-entry accounts and written reckoning are printed for all; partnerships and treasuries can now be checked by any trained clerk.

drypoint_printmaking.name: Drypoint
drypoint_printmaking.observation: An artist scratches straight into the copper with a steel needle, and the ragged burr prints a soft velvet line.

instrument_maker_workshops.name: Instrument-maker Workshops
instrument_maker_workshops.observation: In the lane by the harbour, instrument makers divide brass arcs for quadrants, dials and surveying circles.

printed_alphabet_primers.name: Printed Primers
printed_alphabet_primers.observation: A horn-covered primer of letters and the god's prayers hangs from each child's belt.
printed_alphabet_primers.social_consequence: Reading moves out of the schools and into the kitchens of craftsmen

triangulation_survey.name: Triangulation Survey
triangulation_survey.observation: Surveyors measure one long base line with rods, then fix temple towers across the province by angles alone.

sun_centred_system.name: Sun-centred System
sun_centred_system.observation: A cleric's book sets the sun at the centre and the earth among the wandering stars, and the tables come out simpler.
sun_centred_system.ability_reason: Placing the sun at the centre simplifies the planetary tables and opens the sky to measurement rather than inherited authority.
sun_centred_system.social_consequence: Preachers who read the old texts literally denounce the book, and the schools divide

polynomial_equations.name: Cubic and Quartic Rules
polynomial_equations.observation: Rival masters challenge each other in public to solve cubics, and the winning rule is printed at last.
polynomial_equations.ability_reason: General rules for cubic and quartic equations turn reckoning into a craft with methods, not tricks, and open the road to algebra.

arithmetic_operation_signs.name: Signs for Plus, Minus and Equals
arithmetic_operation_signs.observation: Printed books use crossed and single strokes for adding and taking away, and two parallel lines for 'is equal to'.

merchant_newsletters.name: Merchant Newsletters
merchant_newsletters.observation: Correspondents in each port write weekly letters of prices, cargoes and wars, copied for the merchant houses that pay.

graphite_marking.name: Graphite Pencils
graphite_marking.observation: Soft black lead from the fell is sawn into sticks and cased in cedar, and carpenters and clerks mark without ink.

complex_numbers.name: Roots of Negatives
complex_numbers.observation: A master allows the root of a negative into his working, calls it impossible, and finds the true answer on the other side.

new_star_parallax_test.name: New Star Shows Heavens Change
new_star_parallax_test.observation: A new star blazes in the heavens, shows no shift against the others, and the unchanging spheres are shown to change.

precision_naked_eye_observatory.name: Island Observatory
precision_naked_eye_observatory.observation: On a granted island, a paid staff reads the planets on great brass arcs to a sixth of a degree, night after night.
precision_naked_eye_observatory.ability_reason: Paid observers working great instruments every night make a record of the planets precise enough to test any theory.
precision_naked_eye_observatory.social_consequence: The observatory eats a noble's rents, and the tenants of the island complain of labour dues

reformed_solar_calendar.name: Reformed Calendar
reformed_solar_calendar.observation: Ten days are struck from one month by decree, and the feast of spring returns to its proper moon.
reformed_solar_calendar.social_consequence: Rival rites refuse the new calendar and keep their feasts on different days

symbolic_algebra.name: Symbolic Algebra
symbolic_algebra.observation: Vowels stand for unknowns and consonants for knowns, and a whole family of problems is solved on one line.
symbolic_algebra.ability_reason: Letters for known and unknown quantities let one argument solve a whole class of problems and be checked by others.

two_lens_tube_microscope.name: Two-lens Microscope
two_lens_tube_microscope.observation: Two lenses in a sliding tube show a flea as large as a cat, and the spectacle-makers sell them as wonders.

graded_class_colleges.name: Graded Classes
graded_class_colleges.observation: Teaching colleges divide their boys into ranked classes, each with its own set books, prizes and examinations.

rolling_intaglio_printing.name: Rolling Plate Press
rolling_intaglio_printing.observation: A rolling press forces damp paper into the inked grooves of the plate, and the map comes out sharp to its smallest river.

earth_magnet_treatise.name: The Earth as a Magnet
earth_magnet_treatise.observation: A physician carves a lodestone into a little earth and shows the needle dipping as it does at sea.

measured_kinematics.name: Timed Falling Bodies
measured_kinematics.observation: Brass balls roll down a polished groove while water runs from a vessel, and the distances grow as the squares of the times.
measured_kinematics.ability_reason: Motion measured and timed on inclined planes gives laws that predict where a ball will be, and later where a shot will fall.

printed_weekly_news.name: Weekly News Sheets
printed_weekly_news.observation: A printed sheet of foreign news comes out every week, and the taverns read it as soon as the post arrives.

two_lens_telescope.name: Spyglass
two_lens_telescope.observation: A spectacle-maker's spyglass brings a far ship's flags close, and captains and sky-watchers both demand one.
two_lens_telescope.ability_reason: A spyglass extends sight many times; watchmen and generals see an enemy sooner, and sky-watchers see what no eye has seen.
two_lens_telescope.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Spyglasses from optical lenses, brass and tanned leather, using timber and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

elliptical_planet_orbits.name: Elliptical Orbits
elliptical_planet_orbits.observation: From years of island records a mathematician finds that the red planet runs an ellipse, and the tables finally fit.
elliptical_planet_orbits.ability_reason: Ellipses and the laws of equal areas make the planetary tables accurate, and physical causes begin to replace circles on circles.

telescopic_sky_discoveries.name: What the Spyglass Showed
telescopic_sky_discoveries.observation: Through the spyglass the moon has mountains, the evening star shows phases and the sun wears spots.

lens_centering.name: Centred Lenses
lens_centering.observation: Glass is ground in a turned brass tool and centred on the lathe, so both faces share one axis.

logarithms.name: Logarithms
logarithms.observation: A landed lord's tables turn multiplying into adding, and months of reckoning for the sky-tables become weeks.
logarithms.ability_reason: Logarithms turn multiplication into addition; astronomers, pilots and surveyors do in hours what took days.

decimal_log_tables.name: Common Log Tables
decimal_log_tables.observation: Printed tables of common logarithms to fourteen places sit on every surveyor's and pilot's desk.

compulsory_parish_schooling.name: Compulsory Parish Schooling
compulsory_parish_schooling.observation: The prince decrees that every parish shall keep a school and every child learn to read the catechism.
compulsory_parish_schooling.social_consequence: Children needed in the field are now called to the schoolroom; fines fall on fathers who keep them home

inductive_method_program.name: Method of Induction
inductive_method_program.observation: A statesman's book tells learned men to gather instances in tables and rise to causes step by step.
inductive_method_program.ability_reason: Gathering instances before choosing a cause turns natural knowledge into a common project that can be divided and checked.

logarithmic_slide_rule.name: Slide Rule
logarithmic_slide_rule.observation: Two wooden rules with logarithmic scales slide against each other, and a gauger reads a cask's volume at a glance.

coordinate_geometry.name: Coordinate Geometry
coordinate_geometry.observation: A soldier-philosopher writes curves as equations on two measured lines, and geometry and algebra become one art.
coordinate_geometry.ability_reason: Curves written as equations can be calculated rather than drawn; engineers and gunners can compute paths and shapes.

systematic_doubt_method.name: Method of Doubt
systematic_doubt_method.observation: A thinker doubts everything that can be doubted and builds again from clear and distinct ideas alone.

geared_adding_machine.name: Adding Machine
geared_adding_machine.observation: A tax collector's son builds a box of geared wheels that carries tens by itself; few are sold.

mezzotint_printmaking.name: Mezzotint
mezzotint_printmaking.observation: A plate is roughened all over with a rocker, then scraped smooth where the light should fall.

mercury_barometer.name: Mercury Barometer
mercury_barometer.observation: Quicksilver stands thirty inches in a sealed glass tube, and falls on a mountain and before a storm.
mercury_barometer.ability_reason: The weight of the air is measured; heights, weather and the vacuum itself can now be studied with a number.

vacuum_pumps.name: Air Pump
vacuum_pumps.observation: A town magistrate's pump draws the air from two bronze hemispheres, and teams of horses cannot pull them apart.
vacuum_pumps.ability_reason: An emptied vessel lets air, fire, sound and breath be tested one at a time; the pump becomes the first great apparatus of trial.

probability_theory.name: Reckoning of Chances
probability_theory.observation: Letters between two mathematicians settle how to divide the stakes of a broken game, and annuities are priced the same way.

vacuum_experiments.name: Trials in Emptied Vessels
vacuum_experiments.observation: A bell rings silently in the emptied glass, a candle dies and a mouse falls still.

pendulum_regulated_clock.name: Pendulum Clock
pendulum_regulated_clock.observation: A swinging pendulum governs the clock's wheels, and it keeps time to a few seconds a day instead of a quarter hour.
pendulum_regulated_clock.ability_reason: A pendulum makes clocks accurate to seconds; observations can be timed, work regulated and later longitude pursued.
pendulum_regulated_clock.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Clock Movements from brass, steel and timber, using wrought iron and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

chartered_experimental_society.name: Society for Experiment
chartered_experimental_society.observation: Gentlemen and craftsmen meet each week under the ruler's charter to see trials made and to vote on what they saw.
chartered_experimental_society.ability_reason: A chartered society witnesses and records trials; claims are accepted only when shown, and new knowledge gains a public court.

mechanical_oscillation.name: Pendulums and Strings Measured
mechanical_oscillation.observation: The period of a pendulum and the pitch of a string are measured and found to follow length by simple rules.

air_spring_law.name: Spring of the Air
air_spring_law.observation: Pressed into half the room, the trapped air pushes back twice as hard; the rule holds at every trial.

laboratory_notebooks.name: Dated Trial Notebooks
laboratory_notebooks.observation: Every trial is written on the day it is made, with the weights, the weather and what went wrong.

experimental_protocol_publication.name: Society Journal
experimental_protocol_publication.observation: The society's journal prints each trial in enough detail that a stranger across the sea can repeat it.

microscope_drawing_atlas.name: Microscope Drawings
microscope_drawing_atlas.observation: A folio of engravings shows the eye of a fly, the point of a needle and little cells in a slice of cork.

salaried_science_academy.name: Salaried Academy
salaried_science_academy.observation: The crown pays a small company of learned men to work on questions set by its ministers.

numerical_root_finding.name: Successive Approximation
numerical_root_finding.observation: Guess a root, correct it by the slope, guess again: in three steps the answer is good to six places.

differential_calculus.name: Differential Calculus
differential_calculus.observation: Two rival masters, working apart, find rules for the rate at which any quantity changes.
differential_calculus.ability_reason: Rates of change can be calculated; motion, curves and maxima become problems with methods, and mechanics can be written as law.
differential_calculus.social_consequence: The two masters' followers quarrel across borders over who found it first

experimental_optics.name: Prism Optics
experimental_optics.observation: A prism in a darkened room splits white light into a band of colours, and a second prism does not split them further.

mirror_telescope.name: Mirror Telescope
mirror_telescope.observation: A small polished metal mirror gathers light without the coloured fringes of lenses.

integral_calculus.name: Integral Calculus
integral_calculus.observation: Areas, volumes and centres of weight are found by summing endless thin slices.

realm_longitude_observatory.name: Realm Longitude Observatory
realm_longitude_observatory.observation: The crown builds an observatory on a hill above the river and orders its astronomer to find longitude at sea.

elastic_deformation.name: Stretch in Proportion to Load
elastic_deformation.observation: A spring stretches in proportion to the weight hung from it, and a law is written as an anagram to keep it secret.

light_speed_from_eclipses.name: Speed of Light Found
light_speed_from_eclipses.observation: The eclipses of the moons of the great planet run late when it is far away; light takes minutes to cross the sky.

animalcule_microscope.name: Single-lens Microscope
animalcule_microscope.observation: A draper's tiny bead lens shows swarms of little animals in a drop of rainwater and in the scraping of his teeth.

eyepiece_design.name: Wide-field Eyepieces
eyepiece_design.observation: Two lenses in the eyepiece flatten the field, and the whole moon fits within the view.

stress_strain_relations.name: Stress and Strain in Beams
stress_strain_relations.observation: Beams are loaded and their sag measured, and the stretch of each fibre is set against the force on it.

inertial_motion.name: Inertia
inertial_motion.observation: A body left alone keeps moving in a straight line; it is the stopping, not the moving, that needs a cause.

universal_gravitation.name: Universal Gravitation
universal_gravitation.observation: One law pulls the apple, holds the moon and steers the planets, and the tides answer to it.
universal_gravitation.ability_reason: Laws of motion and one law of gravity explain the heavens and the earth together; mechanics becomes a predictive science.
universal_gravitation.social_consequence: The learned world divides between those who accept a force acting across empty space and those who scorn it

momentum_balance.name: Quantity of Motion Conserved
momentum_balance.observation: Hanging balls are struck together, and the quantity of motion before equals that after.

differential_equations.name: Differential Equations
differential_equations.observation: The swing of a pendulum and the fall of a chain are written as equations of changing quantities and solved.

friction_measurement.name: Friction Measured
friction_measurement.observation: Blocks are dragged by weights over oak and iron, and friction proves a fixed share of the load.

daily_printed_newspaper.name: Daily Newspaper
daily_printed_newspaper.observation: A daily paper of news, prices and advertisements appears before breakfast, and the coffee-houses keep a copy each.
daily_printed_newspaper.social_consequence: Ministers find their conduct in print the next morning

comet_return_prediction.name: Comet's Return Predicted
comet_return_prediction.observation: From old records a mathematician predicts the comet's return for a year he will not live to see; it comes on time.
comet_return_prediction.social_consequence: Comets lose their terror as omens

friction_electric_machine.name: Friction Electric Machine
friction_electric_machine.observation: A spinning ball of sulphur rubbed with the hand throws sparks, and lecturers charge a boy hung on silk cords.

precision_thermometry.name: Sealed Thermometers
precision_thermometry.observation: Sealed tubes of quicksilver marked between freezing and boiling water give the same reading in every city.

public_experiment_lectures.name: Public Lectures of Experiment
public_experiment_lectures.observation: For a silver coin a seat, a lecturer shows air pumps, levers and sparks to merchants and their wives.

structural_load_testing.name: Beams Tested to Breaking
structural_load_testing.observation: Oak beams are loaded until they crack, and the breaking weights go into a table for builders.

subscription_libraries.name: Subscription Libraries
subscription_libraries.observation: Tradesmen pay a gold coin a year to borrow books from a shared room above the bookseller's shop.

flow_continuity.name: Pressure and Speed of Flow
flow_continuity.observation: Water speeds where the pipe narrows and its pressure falls, and one equation ties them together.

numerical_integration.name: Stepwise Sums
numerical_integration.observation: Areas and the paths of comets are found by adding small steps, and computers of tables are hired to do it.

column_buckling.name: Buckling of Columns
column_buckling.observation: A mathematician finds the load at which a slender column suddenly bows, and builders stop trusting thickness alone.

charge_storing_jar.name: Charge-storing Jar
charge_storing_jar.observation: A glass jar coated with foil stores a charge that knocks a row of devotees off their feet.

experimental_controls.name: Controlled Trials
experimental_controls.observation: A ship's surgeon gives oranges to two sailors and cider, vinegar or sea water to the rest, and watches who recovers.
experimental_controls.ability_reason: Comparing treated and untreated groups side by side separates real cures from chance and custom.

reasoned_trades_encyclopedia.name: Reasoned Encyclopedia
reasoned_trades_encyclopedia.observation: Volume after volume of text and engraved plates describes every science and every trade, from pin-making to astronomy.
reasoned_trades_encyclopedia.ability_reason: The methods of every trade are printed with plates; a craft once learned only by apprenticeship can be studied from a book.
reasoned_trades_encyclopedia.social_consequence: Censors ban the volumes, and subscribers buy them anyway

lightning_electricity_trial.name: Lightning Shown Electric
lightning_electricity_trial.observation: A kite flown into a thunderstorm draws sparks from a key, and iron rods begin to rise above steeples.

standard_tongue_dictionary.name: Great Dictionary
standard_tongue_dictionary.observation: A single scholar and six clerks define forty thousand words of the common tongue with quotations for each.

coordinated_transit_expeditions.name: Transit Expeditions
coordinated_transit_expeditions.observation: Observers are sent to far islands and cold coasts to time the planet crossing the sun, and the distance of the sun is found.

mining_engineering_academies.name: Mining Academies
mining_engineering_academies.observation: The crown's mining towns found academies where boys learn assaying, surveying and machines underground.

rotational_dynamics.name: Dynamics of Spinning Bodies
rotational_dynamics.observation: Spinning wheels and tops are described by their moments of inertia and the forces that turn them.

isolated_airs_chemistry.name: Separate Airs
isolated_airs_chemistry.observation: Airs from chalk, iron filings and mercury calx are collected over water and weighed, each different from common air.

calorimetry.name: Heat Measured by Ice
calorimetry.observation: Heat is measured by the ice it melts, and a hot iron is found to hold a different heat than hot water of the same warmth.

flywheel_smoothing.name: Flywheels
flywheel_smoothing.observation: A heavy wheel on the shaft carries the mill through the weak part of each stroke.

oxygen_combustion_theory.name: Burning as Union with an Air
oxygen_combustion_theory.observation: A tax-farmer weighs everything before and after burning and shows that fire takes a part of the air.
oxygen_combustion_theory.ability_reason: Burning and rusting are union with a gas of the air; chemistry becomes a science of weighed elements and compounds.

torsion_balance_force_law.name: Torsion Balance
torsion_balance_force_law.observation: A fine twisted wire measures the push between charged balls, and it falls as the square of the distance.

systematic_chemical_names.name: Chemical Names by Composition
systematic_chemical_names.observation: Old names of vitriols and flowers are replaced with names that say what a substance is made of.

feedback_governors.name: Spinning-weight Governors
feedback_governors.observation: Two spinning weights rise as the mill speeds and close the sluice, so the stones grind evenly.

decimal_earth_measures.name: Decimal Measures
decimal_earth_measures.observation: Surveyors measure an arc of the meridian, and the new length is a ten-millionth part of the way from pole to equator.
decimal_earth_measures.ability_reason: One decimal system of measures taken from the earth replaces hundreds of local ells and bushels; trade and tax can be reckoned the same everywhere.
decimal_earth_measures.social_consequence: Market women keep their old measures, and the new ones must be enforced by inspectors

shutter_signal_frames.name: Shutter Telegraph
shutter_signal_frames.observation: On hilltop towers, six shutters open and close in code, and a message crosses the realm in an hour.

state_polytechnic_school.name: State Polytechnic School
state_polytechnic_school.observation: A state school admits boys by examination and trains them in mathematics, drawing and building for the realm's service.

stone_lithography.name: Lithography
stone_lithography.observation: A drawing made with greasy crayon on limestone is wetted and inked, and prints where the grease took.
